features.name: New global subcontracting app
features.description: Replaces the legacy Italian subcontracting functionality with a globally available subcontracting app that includes advanced capabilities for handling raw materials, work in progress items, and pricing management.
caveats: Requires migration from legacy Italian subcontracting
Significant implementation differences in work in progress handling

features.name: Italian subcontracting migration app
features.description: Dedicated migration app that transfers data from legacy Italian subcontracting to the new global subcontracting app, handling vendors, purchase orders, transfer orders, and pricing.
caveats: Migration was initially blocked in production for feedback
Only available through tenant installation, not AppSource
Requires preparation of open work in progress documents

features.name: Legacy subcontracting pre-check
features.description: Validates the current state before migration by checking for open transfer orders with work in progress items and purchase orders with work in progress items that must be resolved first.
caveats: Pre-check can be skipped but will run anyway during migration

features.name: Work in progress item migration handling
features.description: Key difference between legacy and new subcontracting - requires closing or removing all open transfer orders and purchase orders containing work in progress items before migration can proceed.
caveats: Customers can choose to post, delete, or cancel documents

features.name: Subcontracting application area toggle
features.description: Controls visibility of legacy subcontracting fields and pages versus new subcontracting functionality. When legacy subcontracting is disabled, the system switches the application area setting to activate new subcontracting and hide legacy fields.
caveats: Cannot be activated without migration if legacy data exists
Toggle is guarded by system logic

features.name: Subcontracting purchase and transfer order views
features.description: After migration, legacy subcontracting dedicated pages are removed. Purchase and transfer orders are consolidated into standard lists with filter views for subcontracting orders.
caveats: Dedicated legacy pages no longer available
Requires use of views to filter subcontracting-specific documents

features.name: Vendor subcontracting field migration
features.description: Vendor-level fields including subcontractor indicator and subcontracting location code are migrated from legacy Italian subcontracting to the new app.
caveats: Field values are migrated but stored in new tables

features.name: Subcontracting prices migration
features.description: Pricing information defined for subcontractors in the legacy system is migrated to the new subcontracting app pricing tables.
